message: Rebrand the project from MoonTV to KatelyaTV, including code and data migration, to establish it as a derivative project. This PR updates UI text, default configurations, and internal keys/symbols. Backward compatibility for user data (play records, favorites, search history, cache) stored in localStorage and Upstash Redis is implemented to ensure a smooth transition for existing users. Version check URLs are also made configurable while retaining upstream MoonTV as a fallback. ---
